answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique physical decay signature, much as RTG degradation kinetics let us fingerprint a genuine Pu-238 source against a counterfeit walnut-sized decoy. Each agent stakes capital behind a willow-entropy challenge whose answer must mirror its measured thermal decay curve, so duplicate personas cannot share one. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
